tools.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Change the current working directory to the specified folder.
tools.name: cd

folder.description: The folder of the directory to change to. You can only change one folder level at a time.

current_working_directory.description: The new current working directory path.

tools.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Copy a file or directory from one location to another.  If the destination is a directory, the source file or directory will be copied into the destination directory.  Both source and destination must be local to the current directory.
tools.name: cp

destination.description: The destination name to copy the file or directory to. If the destination is a directory, the source will be copied into this directory. No file paths allowed.

source.description: The name of the file or directory to copy.

result.description: The result of the copy operation or an error message if the operation fails.
